individuals.title: Edit Check
individuals.quote: Offer people actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies while they are editing.

individuals.title: Reference check
individuals.quote: The first "check" the Editing Team will be introducing is one that will detect when people are attempting to add *new* content to an existing article *without* a corresponding reference and prompt them to do so.

individuals.title: Link check and Reference reliability
individuals.quote: **Link check and Reference reliability**

individuals.title: Paste Check
individuals.quote: **Paste Check**

individuals.title: Tone check
individuals.quote: **Tone check**

individuals.title: Suggestion Mode
individuals.quote: The feature has been available as a Beta Feature globally since early March and at English Wikipedia since early February.

individuals.title: TextMatch
individuals.quote: Some communities have started to use the textMatch feature to create custom local types of Suggestion.

individuals.title: Add an image suggestion type
individuals.quote: A new experimental suggestion type, "Add an image", has been created using the same functionality as the Growth team's version.

individuals.title: Add a link suggestion type
individuals.quote: Work is also ongoing on improving the functionality of the "Add a link" suggestion type, so that it can become a default global suggestion type in the future.

individuals.title: addReference suggestions
individuals.quote: Better detection of existing references for the `addReference` suggestions

individuals.title: Hide suggestions toggle-button
individuals.quote: Addition of a toggle-button to hide suggestions temporarily - this will soon also save the 'hidden' state across future edit-sessions

individuals.title: Multi-Check
individuals.quote: Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours

individuals.title: Edit Check desktop siderail
individuals.quote: This change shifted Edit Checks from appearing *within* articles to appearing *alongside* them, in a new "siderail."

individuals.title: Special:EditChecks
individuals.quote: Clearer and more accurate details in `Special:EditChecks` which shows the local configuration

individuals.title: Visual editor
individuals.quote: The Editing Team is working on a set of improvements for the visual editor to help new volunteers understand and follow some of the policies and guidelines

individuals.title: editcheck/init.js
individuals.quote: The conditions above are implemented and maintained in code here: editcheck/init.js

individuals.title: Editing Team
individuals.quote: The Editing Team is working on a set of improvements for the visual editor

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation Product Department
individuals.quote: why the Wikimedia Foundation's Product Department is prioritizing this work

individuals.title: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of

individuals.title: Moderators at English and French Wikipedias
individuals.quote: Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making

individuals.title: Experienced volunteers
individuals.quote: **Experienced volunteers/moderators** – need to do more work reverting low-quality edits

individuals.title: Administrators at all Wikipedias
individuals.quote: Administrators at all Wikipedias can help to configure this tool so that it can recognize local standard heading-names

individuals.title: Learning the basics means fewer than 100 edits
individuals.quote: we are considering people who are still "learning the basics" to be people who have published <100 cumulative edits to a single, or multiple, Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Newcomers feel safe and confident publishing useful changes
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of and that experienced volunteers consider useful.

individuals.title: Moderators notice quality improvements and configure Edit Check
individuals.quote: Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making and be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them.

individuals.title: Offer actionable policy feedback while editing
individuals.quote: Offering inexperienced volunteers relevant and actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies in the precious moments when they are in the midst of making a change using the visual editor.

individuals.title: Equip moderators to specify feedback shown
individuals.quote: Equipping moderators with a new ability to specify the feedback inexperienced volunteers are presented with while they are editing

individuals.title: Editing interfaces do not surface policies
individuals.quote: The trouble is that the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow.

individuals.title: Inexperienced volunteers become frustrated by reverts
individuals.quote: become disappointed and frustrated when the good-faith change(s) they arrived to the wiki seeking to make are undone (read: reverted), deleted, and/or scrutinized in inequitable ways.

individuals.title: Experienced volunteers burdened reverting low-quality edits
individuals.quote: need to do more work reverting low-quality edits and posting messages on inexperienced volunteers' talk pages to make them aware of the policies and/or guidelines they are likely to have unknowingly broken.

individuals.title: Wikipedia projects struggle to grow and diversify
individuals.quote: struggle to grow and diversify their volunteer populations and shrink the knowledge gaps present within Wikimedia wikis.

individuals.title: Newcomers twice as likely in Africa or Asia
individuals.quote: Newcomers are two times more likely to live in Africa or Asia.

individuals.title: Movement struggles to retain non-European editors
individuals.quote: The movement struggles to retain editors who live outside Europe and North America.

individuals.title: Sub-Saharan Africa underrepresented among editors
individuals.quote: people from Sub-Saharan Africa represent only 1% of active unique editors, despite representing 15% of the global population and 7% of the global internet population.

individuals.title: 80% of SSA editors contribute to English or French
individuals.quote: 80% of registered editors in Sub-Saharan Africa contribute to English or French Wikipedia.

individuals.title: LLMs effective at checking source corroboration in English
individuals.quote: This research confirmed that in English LLMs are effective at evaluating whether web-based sources corroborate claims on Wikipedia.

individuals.title: Surface relevant guidance while volunteers edit
individuals.quote: we first need to make the norms and standards that are currently in place legible and actionable to people while they are editing.

individuals.title: Minimize false positives with volunteer-evolvable heuristic
individuals.quote: the Editing Team is pursuing an approach with Edit Check that minimizes the likelihood of false positives and is implemented in ways that empower volunteers, on a per-project basis, to evolve the heuristic to become more robust over time.

individuals.title: Moderators empowered to configure Edit Check
individuals.quote: The Editing Team thinks it is crucial that moderators be empowered to configure when, and for whom, Edit Check becomes activated.

individuals.title: Reference check activation conditions
individuals.quote: A minimum of one new paragraph of text is added to the article someone is editing

individuals.title: Make guidance intuitive so newcomers return
individuals.quote: Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors find the guidance Edit Check is presenting them with, and the editing experience more broadly, to be intuitive and straightforward so that they feel encourage to return to edit again

individuals.title: Avoid creating extra work for experienced volunteers
individuals.quote: Decrease the likelihood that Edit Check is creating more work for experienced volunteers by prompting newcomers and Junior Contributors to add sources when they are not needed

individuals.title: Audit and edit reference check activation logic
individuals.quote: **Audit** and **edit** the logic that determines when the reference Edit Check becomes activated

individuals.title: Review edits by people shown Edit Check
individuals.quote: **Review** the edits people who are shown Edit Check are making

individuals.title: Mobile visual editor publishing workflow
individuals.quote: The first version of Edit Check will introduce a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow

individuals.title: Reference check publishing step
individuals.quote: a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow that people will see if/when they add new content *without* a reference.

individuals.title: Multi-Check deployment June 25, 2025
individuals.quote: Multi-Check was deployed to all wikis where Reference Check is currently available on June 25, 2025.

individuals.title: December 2024 desktop design release
individuals.quote: In December 2024, we released a new design for the Edit Check desktop experience.

individuals.title: Suggestion Mode global Beta release (March 2026)
individuals.quote: The feature has been available as a Beta Feature globally since early March

individuals.title: Multi-Check (References) A/B Test
individuals.quote: we ran an A/B test with 12 Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Reference Check A/B Test
individuals.quote: To learn whether the Reference Edit Check is effective at causing **newcomers to make edits they intended and experienced volunteers value**, we conducted an A/B test with 15 Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Suggestion Mode A/B experiment
individuals.quote: The A/B experiment was launched on 15 wikis and is collecting data.

individuals.title: Multi-Check increased referenced unreverted edits
individuals.quote: Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours without causing undesirable changes in edit completion

individuals.title: Siderail reduced revert rate by 15.7%
individuals.quote: The revert rate of new content edits where Reference Check was activated decreased by **15.7%**.

individuals.title: Reference Check 2.2x more referenced constructive edits
individuals.quote: People shown the Reference Check are **2.2 times more likely** to publish a new content edit that includes a reference and is constructive (not reverted within 48 hours).

individuals.title: Revert rate decreased 8.6% with Reference Check
individuals.quote: New content edit revert rate **decreased by 8.6%** if Reference Check was available.

individuals.title: SSA edits 53% less likely reverted
individuals.quote: New content edits by contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa are **53% less likely** to be reverted when Reference Check is shown to eligible edits.

individuals.title: 16% higher constructive retention
individuals.quote: Contributors that are shown Reference Check and successfully save a non-reverted edit are **16 percent more likely** to return to make a non-reverted edit in their second month

individuals.title: Increase quality of newcomer edits in main namespace
individuals.quote: Increase the quality of edits newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa publish in the main namespace

individuals.title: Increase likelihood newcomers add references
individuals.quote: Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will accompany the new content they are adding with a reference

individuals.title: Newcomers report feeling safe and confident
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will report feeling safe and confident making changes to Wikipedia

individuals.title: Experienced volunteers iterate on Edit Check configuration
individuals.quote: Experienced volunteers will independently audit and iterate upon Edit Check's default configurations to ensure Edit Check is causing newcomers and Junior Contributors to make productive edits.

individuals.title: Newcomers more aware of need for references
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors will be more aware of the need to add a reference when contributing new content because the visual editor will prompt them to do so

individuals.title: Risk: edit quality decreases
individuals.quote: Edit quality decreases

individuals.title: Risk: unreliable citations harder to patrol
individuals.quote: Edits become more difficult to patrol because unreliable citations are difficult to detect

individuals.title: Risk: edit completion rate drastically decreases
individuals.quote: Edit completion rate drastically decreases

individuals.title: Risk: edit abandonment rate drastically increases
individuals.quote: Edit abandonment rate drastically increases

individuals.title: Risk: blocks increase
individuals.quote: Blocks increase

individuals.title: Risk: high false positive or negative rates
individuals.quote: High false positive or false negative rates

individuals.title: Risk: Edit Check too resource intensive to scale
individuals.quote: Edit Check is too resource intensive to scale
